name: presentation-converter
description: Convert Keynote, PowerPoint, Google Slides and ODP presentations to PDF with a presenter-notes sidecar
author: Allan Sargeant

scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace @presentation-converter/web && npm run build --workspace @presentation-converter/server && npm run build --workspace @presentation-converter/cli
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && npm run dev --workspace @presentation-converter/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
